mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supervision_alert ( school_id, offering_id, session_id, alert_type, dedup_key, scan_run_id, severity, title, description, metric_value, threshold_value, rectification_deadline ) VALUES ( #{draft.schoolId}, #{draft.offeringId}, #{draft.sessionId}, #{draft.alertType}, #{draft.dedupKey}, #{scanRunId}, #{draft.severity}, #{draft.title}, #{draft.description}, #{draft.metricValue}, #{draft.thresholdValue}, #{deadline} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dedup_key = dedup_key

INSERT INTO supervision_alert_action ( school_id, alert_id, from_status, to_status, action_type, comment, actor_id, actor_role ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, #{alertId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actionType}, #{comment}, #{actorId}, #{actorRole} )
mapper.sql: sa.id, sa.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_code AS schoolCode, s.school_name AS schoolName, sa.offering_id AS offeringId, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, o.term_id AS termId, COALESCE(at.term_name, o.term) AS termName, c.course_name AS courseName, c.category, t.full_name AS teacherName, sa.session_id AS sessionId, ls.session_date AS sessionDate, ls.start_time AS sessionStartTime, ls.end_time AS sessionEndTime, sa.alert_type AS alertType, sa.severity, sa.status, sa.title, sa.description, sa.metric_value AS metricValue, sa.threshold_value AS thresholdValue, sa.rectification_deadline AS rectificationDeadline, sa.detected_at AS detectedAt, sa.closed_at AS closedAt, sa.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN sa.status <> 'CLOSED' AND sa.rectification_deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS overdue
mapper.update: UPDATE supervision_alert SET status = #{toStatus}, closed_at = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} = 'CLOSED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
